_provenance.description: Curated BBH merger parameters for the merger-mode animation. Median source-frame values (uncertainties omitted) from the GWTC-2.1 catalog, LIGO-Virgo Collaboration, via the GWOSC event portal (https://gwosc.org/eventapi/). Values rounded; consult the DOI for posteriors. BNS/NSBH events excluded (no matter modeling in this renderer).

fields.fLow: GW frequency (Hz, detector frame) at which the animation/audio starts
fields.audioShiftOct: default frequency shift in octaves for audibility (0 = as detected; labeled in UI, as in LIGO's released audio)

events.name: GW150914
events.note: The first direct detection of gravitational waves.

events.name: GW151226
events.note: Light system - long inspiral chirping to high frequency.

events.name: GW190412
events.note: Strongly asymmetric masses - higher harmonics observed.

events.name: GW190521
events.note: Most massive - intermediate-mass black hole remnant; low-frequency chirp shifted +2 octaves for audibility.
